fact: On 21 January 2025 the Minister of Communication, Technology and Innovation told a government press briefing that the ministry had implemented the National Digital Development Policy and the National Innovation and Digital Strategy and passed a National Broadband Strategy, citing a $132 million investment, 1,641 km of fibre rollout and mobile coverage gains.
title: Minister Salima outlines Accomplishments in the Tech Sector
publisher: Ministry of Information and Civic Education
